summary: An explosion near a school in Afghanistan has resulted in conflicting casualty figures from officials.

BBC News reported that a spokesperson for Afghanistan's interior ministry said the blast killed 10 students and injured more than 100 people, attributing the incident to carelessness at a nearby explosives depot.

An official cautioned to Al Jazeera that these numbers were preliminary and subject to change. DW reported that officials linked the blast to improperly stored explosives that ignited at a mining site, damaging surrounding buildings.
Authorities noted that an investigation into the explosion remains ongoing, according to DW.
